spiritgiven.comments: Thanks New Zealand for a great first game and a very spirited game, we had no major issues and any small issues were resolved quickly. Good luck in the rest of the tournament!!
Thank you Canada for the great game, we had no issues whatsoever regarding spirit and it was a pleasure to play you guys!
Thank you germany for the great game, good luck for the rest of the tournament :)
Thank you for the game guys!
Thank you Italy for the well spirited game!

Thank you belgium for the game, we thought spirit was mostly decent the 1 in attitude was for some of the things said on the sideline that we found unspirited such as calling for “callaghans” but other than that it was a good game. Thank you!

Thanks for the game China, just to explain the 1s we gave a 1 in rules as we talked to them about double teaming and it did continue at points. the 1 in fair mindedness is because sometimes we felt as calls were only made to benefit in their team. and 1 in communication as we were asked for a low contact game before the game but we felt that they also were very physical. good luck in the rest of the tournament
the communication is because we thought you guys could’ve talked to us about offsides and timing violations before making lots of calls

spiritreceived.comments: great game, they kept positive attitude and communicated with us a lot. the things need to be improved are that first their coaches might stay too long when change a line, which could be called as delay. and also, please watch out the potential momentum that would cause collision, especially if you have the vision - which is the rule. tysm!
It was a really good game, good spirit, they had some issues with their spirit but they kept a very good attitude during the game.
We would like to thank Ireland for the amazing intense game!
